diagnosis.observed: The overlay host was connected and was the current document host. Its HappyDOM virtual console recorded an Application crash: ReferenceError: MessageChannel is not defined, from messageQueue.scheduleDeferredDrain.
diagnosis.causalBoundary: HappyDOM21 Window lacks the standard browser MessageChannel primitive. Contention crossing the existing5ms Message-drain budget exposed it. No production readiness or dropped-store-event bug was demonstrated.

changes: Install real Node22 MessageChannel in this test Window before executing the generated client; count delivered tasks without replacing port behavior.
Track created channels and close both ports in test cleanup before closing the Window.
Force each existing overlay mode through a budget yield during its single badge click, holding new frames so the budget is not reset prematurely. Restore clock/RAF and release frames in finally.
Retain the precise badge selector, panel-open check, and every original counter/history/inspector/single-mount/client-environment assertion.
Keep a holding flag for scheduled frame wrappers: clear it before releasing held frames, and invoke late wrapper callbacks normally with the native scheduler timestamp.

normalLintEnabledForFile.note: Default repository normal lint excludes this entire package. A temporary identical config with only that package exclusion removed scanned the owned test and was removed in finally.

limits: No production source, package builds/dist, timeouts, dependency pins, or repeated-click retries changed for the overlay repair.
The final full-plugin integration run is delegated to the parent after this freeze; the only full run here was the causal red diagnostic.

lateFrameFollowup.confirmed: A requestFrame callback could still be pending when finally released heldFrames; the old wrapper would append after the release loop and strand that callback.
lateFrameFollowup.listenerRemoval: Retained HappyDOM21's two-argument removeEventListener API. Its implementation checks both bubbling and capturing listener maps; its declaration accepts exactly two arguments. No bound signature or wrapper remains.
lateFrameFollowup.controlsScope: The prior three mutation controls ran on 1d2069892e06ebdcf533d7ace9ad74a492b5829ae8878a20838007a3d93746ff, before this holding-flag followup. They are preserved as exact-artifact receipts, not claimed rerun on this final hash. No broad suite rerun here.
